calculation.expression: (-clip(ret_5 - cross_sectional_median(ret_5), upper=0) / rolling_mean(abs(clip(daily_return, upper=0)), 30)) * (1 + clip(max(ret_60 - cross_sectional_median(ret_60), 0), upper=0.5)); then shift(1)
calculation.description: Rewards five-session relative laggards for a subsequent rebound, but only in proportion to positive sixty-session relative trend, with downside-risk normalization and a one-session information lag. The signal is cross-sectional and higher values indicate stronger expected forward return.

validation.regime_notes: Positive in both evaluated regimes and strongest at the 60-day horizon; uncertainty remains material for a 15-instrument cross-section. Signal is moderately high turnover and substantially overlaps at least one existing residual-reversal artifact, so ensemble redundancy should be monitored.
